t: A Fluidizer is built using the following parts.$(br2)All parts are mandatory, with the exception of Glass, which can be used in place of a Casing block in the four vertical faces of the machine, and the Injectors.$(br2)The type and number of Injectors in the machine will define its $(l:bigreactors:fluidizer/operational_mode)operational mode$(/l).
流化器由以下部件构成。$(br2)除玻璃和注入器外，所有部件都是必需的；玻璃可以在机器四个垂直面上替代外壳方块使用。$(br2)机器中注入器的类型和数量将决定其$(l:bigreactors:fluidizer/operational_mode)运行模式$(/l)。
